title: 🔥 “The cross proves that God can turn any weapon into a witness.”
paragraphs:
🔥 “The cross proves that God can turn any weapon into a witness.”
When life tries to break you — remember, God can use the very thing meant to destroy you to declare His glory. 💫

What the enemy used to wound you, God will use to win others.
Every scar, every storm, every weapon… becomes your testimony. ✝️

🎬 From pain to purpose. From weapon to witness.
#TheCrossProvesIt

“But God chose what the world calls foolish to shame the wise, and what the world calls weak to shame the strong.”
— 1 Corinthians 1:27 (NIV)
